:::{#about}


I am a Software Engineer at Waymo, working on autonomous driving in Mountain
View, California. Previously, I was a PhD researcher in autonomous systems
focusing on real-time motion planning and control for autonomous racing. My
work combined model-based approaches and learning-based methods, with a
strong emphasis on full-system integration and practical validation in
simulation and on real platforms, and I remain particularly interested in
building complete, real-time software systems that connect theory with
experimental results.
